name: agent2host
description: Persistent native shells across local and SSH hosts, including Android targets attached through adb.

interface.shortDescription: Give coding agents persistent access to your hosts.
interface.longDescription: Add local or SSH hosts, keep native PTY sessions alive through a local daemon, and let coding agents execute commands, edit files, and control Android targets attached to any host without installing an agent remotely.
defaultPrompt: List my hosts and open a persistent development shell.
List Android targets attached to my Mac mini and inspect the selected phone.
